task_title: PM lane: re-measure the acceptance plan and the PRD milestone at bc68e59, name the two unowned selftest arms (§34/§35), and correct the CF-110 destroy claim
task_criteria: C1: from the repo root, bash docs/audits/cf099-prd-drift-probe.sh exits 0 and prints a line starting 'OK: milestone, plan snapshot and layer arms agree at' naming the committed HEAD.

C2: docs/ACCEPTANCE-PLAN.md's current-state line names the tip bc68e59 and the counts that tip carries — git show bc68e59:.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl | wc -l = 148 and the events file = 273 — and grep -c '^say "[0-9]+\.' tests/selftest.sh = 35.

C3: the reverse-mapping paragraph in docs/ACCEPTANCE-PLAN.md states 12 of 37 arms are named by a requirement cell and enumerates the remaining 25 arms including §34 and §35; the mapping table carries a §35 row naming board row CF-153 and a §34 row naming CF-163.

C4: the CF-110 cell in docs/PRD-code-factory.md quotes grep -rn destroy scripts/*.sh as 2 hits and states both are advisory (a comment at node-create.sh:12 and a printf at node-create.sh:54), with no automated destroy path shipping.
C5: bash tests/selftest.sh exits 0 printing SELFTEST: PASS at the committed HEAD.
